govdocs-archive_org-the-bogomils-of-bulg: The Bogomils of Bulgaria and Bosnia studies a medieval Christian heresy in the Balkans. The Bogomils held a dualist faith, seeing the material world as the work of an evil power. Its subtitle calls them the early Protestants of the East, centuries before the Reformation. The volume traces their beliefs and their fate under pressure from church and empire. It serves readers of Balkan and heresy history.
